comment: Copy to clients.json in the state dir and replace the hashes:  printf %s 'THE-RAW-KEY' | sha256sum . Raw keys are shown to the client once and never stored. Policies per spec v0.5.3 client table: Hermes $1/day target no premium; OpenClaw $3/day target, premium at level 5 or explicit request, premium alerts $20/mo and >20 premium req/day; n8n $0.50/day target no premium. Targets history: spec defaults Hermes  / OpenClaw  / n8n /bin/bash.50; Week 2 gate reset derived from Phase 0 + shadow + burn-in data (Hermes /bin/bash.25 / OpenClaw  / n8n /bin/bash.50), then Jordan bumped the reset 5x on 2026-11-03 — final applied targets Hermes .25 / OpenClaw .00 / n8n .50 per day.
